changes.after: This supplies the integral identities for C¹ tangent fields on a finite product of spheres with its actual normalized product measure. Proof strategy: Fix the normalized surface measure; Obtain radial regularity from the sphere charts; Identify the actual tangent differential and gradient; Identify divergence with the induced tangent trace; Build an annular field and compute its divergence; Use ambient divergence and polar transport; Apply the product rule on one sphere; Transport each coordinate identity to the finite product; Sum the coordinates and conclude integration by parts.

This applies the product-sphere identity to a scalar weight times the coordinate gradient of a C² function. Proof strategy: Differentiate the joint radial extension; Recover a jointly C¹ tangent gradient; Construct the weighted tangent field; Substitute into the proved product identity.
